title: TC-CS-CTM-Pentesting-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Title: Attack & Penetration Testing – Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 3-4 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3-4 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.

**What We Look For**

* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders and platform owners to understand business criticality, reporting dependencies, and control requirements for supported services.
* Coordinate with architecture, engineering, operations, security, and risk teams to clarify control ownership and resolve governance gaps without duplicating responsibilities.
* Facilitate governance forums, prepare decision papers, record decisions and approvals, and track agreed actions to completion.
* Communicate governance status, emerging risks, exceptions, audit readiness, and remediation progress clearly to management and business stakeholders.

**Governance Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Standardize reusable control checklists, evidence templates, onboarding criteria, and exception workflows to improve consistency and reduce administrative effort.
* Work with engineering teams to automate control monitoring and evidence collection where feasible, including policy-as-code checks and governance dashboards.
* Review lessons from incidents, audits, and control failures; recommend framework improvements and track evidence of resilience testing, lifecycle reviews, and secure service retirement.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: SAP GRC/Security
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for a Technology Architect focuses on designing and governing secure SAP landscapes with a strong emphasis on SAP Security SAP GRC Access Control and ABAP Authorization for complex enterprise environments. The architect will translate business risk requirements into scalable security architectures ensure robust compliance controls and guide implementation teams toward sustainable solutions that protect critical data assets while enabling efficient business operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive SAP security architectures that align with enterprise risk posture and compliance objectives while supporting scalable business processes across multiple SAP systems and modules
* Oversee configuration and optimization of SAP GRC Access Control components to enforce risk based access policies and ensure consistent governance of user provisioning and access review activities
* Provide expert guidance on ABAP Authorization design including roles creation authorization objects and permission strategies that minimize risk exposure and streamline access management workflows
* Drive end to end assessment of existing SAP security controls and GRC frameworks to identify gaps recommend remediation actions and prioritize enhancements that strengthen overall security resilience
* Develop detailed security design documents and standards that describe roles segregation of duties rules workflow configurations and control mechanisms for implementation teams to follow
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants and technical developers to embed security and authorization requirements into solution designs ensuring traceability to regulatory and business obligations
* Coordinate periodic reviews of user access risk violations audit findings and compliance reports generated through SAP GRC and related tools translating insights into actionable improvement plans
* Guide performance optimization and stability of authorization checks in ABAP and SAP applications ensuring secure operations without compromising response times or user experience in day to day business activities
* Implement robust controls for transport management change governance and emergency access handling in SAP landscapes to reduce operational risk and maintain strong audit readiness across environments
* Support hybrid work model collaboration by establishing secure connectivity guidelines device access standards and data protection practices that enable flexible working while safeguarding sensitive information
* Contribute to company purpose by designing security solutions that protect mission critical data and processes enabling reliable delivery of products and services that positively impact clients and communities
* Advise stakeholders on how domain understanding of data models and computational biology can be securely integrated with SAP platforms where relevant ensuring appropriate protection of research and analytical data assets
* Document architecture decisions patterns and security baselines in a clear and reusable form that helps teams sustain secure operations and reduces future onboarding time for new initiatives

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience in SAP Security across multiple modules with proven ability to design and maintain complex role structures and authorization concepts for large scale organizations
* Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in SAP GRC Access Control including configuration of risk rules user provisioning workflows access risk analysis and periodic access review processes
* Show advanced proficiency in ABAP Authorization concepts including authorization objects role design field level restrictions and troubleshooting of authorization issues in custom and standard applications
* Bring practical exposure to enterprise data models with capability to interpret how data structures and relationships influence access control strategies and security design for business critical information
* Exhibit familiarity with computational biology or similar analytical domains enabling secure handling of research data models and specialized workflows where they intersect with SAP and related systems

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – Digital Risk – Senior – IT Internal Controls:**
At EY, we are all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We will help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Are you a tech-savvy professional with a risk mindset who is passionate about building a better working world through the power of people, technology, and innovation? We have an incredible opportunity for you to join our dynamic Digital Risk team and make a real impact in the rapidly evolving world we live in. Within Risk Consulting, you will focus in the areas of areas of IT Risk Management, IT SOX, IT Regulatory Compliance, IT Audits, IT and Digital Transformations (including ERP and Cloud transformations), while enabling technology to better manage risk. As a member of our team, you will have the chance to work with industry leaders and help transform businesses by tackling the most complex challenges with our clients.
  
  
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You will also team up with our global professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. You will be leveraging emerging technologies like AI, ML, to build and enhance new solutions and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional IT Risk Advisor.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
* Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
* Use knowledge of the current IT environment and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.
* Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business & related industry issues / trends for global clients.
* Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement.
* Conduct knowledge sharing discussions & contribute to EY thought leadership.
* Understanding our clients’ overall technology strategy to effectively manage risk while transforming their business.
* Manage day-to-day client relationships, leading client meetings, working sessions, and status reporting.
* Stay up to date with emerging industry trends and technologies, suggest innovative solutions to engagement teams and provide recommendations to clients on potential risks and opportunities.
* Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of IT risk, information security frameworks such as COSO, COBIT etc.
* IT Risk and Controls assessment with exposure of any of the technologies such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, MS Dynamics or emerging technologies such as Cloud, RPA, AI/ML
* Cognitive problem-solving capabilities, quick decision-making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanour.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
* Effective organization and time management skills with the ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to think differently and innovate

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Chartered accountant (CA) or Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Management, Information Systems/ Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* Passion for technology and an ardent desire to work in risk management.
* Approximately 3-6 years of related work experience in Risks & Controls, IT Risk Management, IT Audit.

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, collaborate with cross functional teams including internal audits, IT security and business stakeholders to assess control effectiveness and facilitate remediation activities.
* Good to have relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant).

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior Big 4 or consulting leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success in market development or sector focused propositions.
* Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
* Coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tech S and T-Wintel Platform and Migration Specialist-ISR - Manager-GDSF02

**Migration Specialist & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
**Experience**
: 5–8 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a
**Migration Specialist & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
to support enterprise-scale infrastructure and platform migration programs across cloud and on-premises environments. The role will focus on Active Directory modernization, hybrid identity integration, and x86 platform migrations to enable secure, scalable, and high-performing enterprise infrastructure.
  
  
**Job Description**
The candidate will be responsible for planning and executing infrastructure and platform migrations, including Active Directory transformation and cloud adoption initiatives. The role includes end-to-end migration lifecycle activities such as discovery, assessment, planning, migration execution, validation, and post-migration optimization across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute platform migrations across x86 infrastructure, including VMware, Nutanix, Dell, and Azure Local environments.
* Lead Active Directory migration, consolidation, and modernization initiatives across enterprise environments.
* Design and implement hybrid cloud infrastructure and identity integration using Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Perform infrastructure discovery, assessment, dependency mapping, and migration planning.
* Execute cloud migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, and modernization approaches.
* Manage and optimize Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, replication, and domain controllers.
* Ensure infrastructure performance, scalability, security, and operational stability after migration.
* Troubleshoot complex migration, identity, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments.
* Collaborate with cloud, security, application, and operations teams to deliver seamless transformation outcomes.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology
* 5-8 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, migration delivery, and cloud environments.
* Strong experience in platform migrations across VMware, Nutanix, and x86 infrastructure environments.
* Hands-on expertise in Active Directory, including multi-domain environments, Group Policy, DNS, replication, and domain controllers.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity integration.
* Proven experience in executing Active Directory migration and infrastructure transformation programs.
* Experience with Azure cloud infrastructure and migration tools.
* Strong understanding of cloud migration methodologies, migration waves, cutover planning, and best practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage large-scale migration projects in fast-paced enterprise environments.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for infrastructure operations.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager, formerly SCCM.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management.
* Familiarity with endpoint security, compliance, and governance frameworks.
* Exposure to automation, monitoring tools, ITSM processes, and DevOps practices.
* Working Expectations
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear documentation for design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, operational procedures, and quality expectations

title: Risk Consulting - Sanctions Screening a Transaction Monitoring Model Validation - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Risk Consulting – Senior Consultant (Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring Model Validation)**
As part of our Risk Consulting – FS team, we are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst contributing to the delivery of Risk Consulting – FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As a Senior Consultant, you will engage with clients to support the validation and enhancement of sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are aligned with regulatory standards and operational requirements. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will support the validation and fine-tuning of models/tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing subject matter knowledge and supporting the implementation of solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
  
  
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support sanctions screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems, anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms.
* Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis to assess model design, effectiveness, performance and compliance with regulatory expectations.
* Execute model testing activities including back-testing, threshold calibration, data analysis and performance assessments.
* Analyse large volumes of transactional and customer data to identify trends, gaps and potential model improvements.
* Assist in the development and enhancement of validation methodologies, frameworks and performance metrics.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the integration of model outputs into business processes.
* Participate in model implementation reviews, fine-tuning exercises and model performance monitoring activities.
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and model validation techniques.
* Support multiple client engagements and related initiatives while ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
* Good to have experience in Risk Management or other Risk Consulting engagements.
* The job would require travel (Over 50%) to client locations in Middle East and North Africa such as Dubai, Kuwait, Riyadh, Doha etc.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proficient in SQL and Python.
* Familiarity with database management and data analysis tools.
* Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project delivery.
* Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) regulations and screening tools.
* Understanding of sanctions screening systems, transaction monitoring platforms and model validation methodologies.
* Exceptional command over spoken and written English.
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
* Highly analytical, organised, and meticulous consulting skills; attention to detail and quality assurance.
* Ability to work collaboratively within engagement teams and contribute effectively to project delivery.
* Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively.
* Work experience in similar industry (Big 4 preferred).
* Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Finance, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience working with business consulting firms.
* A valid passport for travel.

**Preferably, you may also have**

* AML, CTF Certification (CAMS, CAFP).
* Experience / certifications in Cloud Data Architecture, Data Engineering.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

title: SOC Intern

* SIEM/SOAR
* EDR/XDR
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft 365 Security
* Azure Security
* AWS Security
* Threat Intelligence
* Incident Response

* Degree/Diploma in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of networking and operating systems.

* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong interest in Security Operations and Cybersecurity.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
This role ensures cybersecurity efforts are not only executed effectively, but also measurable, traceable, and defensible. The Cyber Security Analyst will help structure and maintain the processes, data, and documentation required to support security operations, risk and remediation tracking, control validation, and compliance readiness.
  
  
The analyst will work across engineering, operations, OT and IT security teams, and regulatory and compliance stakeholders to maintain asset and system visibility, support security reviews and assessments, validate security controls, track vulnerabilities and remediation activities, and ensure documentation and reporting are audit-ready and reliable.
  
  
Success in this role will be demonstrated through accurate and accessible asset inventory and system data, consistent and repeatable security processes, effective tracking of risks and vulnerabilities through closure, verified and defensible security controls, and reliable, audit-ready documentation and reporting.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Organize and maintain asset and system visibility.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, external assessments, and third-party security reviews.
* Support administration of OT security platforms.
* Validate and test that security controls are implemented and operating as intended.
* Develop reporting and dashboards to provide insight into risk and compliance posture.
* Coordinate cybersecurity processes across engineering, operations, and security teams.
* Participate in risk assessments for new or evolving technologies, systems, and third-party services.
* Track the progress of security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and configuration and change activities.
* Ensure defined processes, including risk assessments, approvals, and reviews, are consistently followed.
* Coordinate security reviews, remediation efforts, and assurance activities.
* Identify gaps in workflows and contribute to process improvements.
* Maintain and support accurate inventory of OT and digital assets across environments.
* Organize system-level information, including ownership, network relationships, and configuration baselines.
* Support configuration monitoring efforts by identifying and validating changes within control systems.
* Administer and support OT security platforms used for asset visibility, configuration monitoring, vulnerability management, and threat detection.
* Assist with tuning and improving platform outputs to reduce noise and improve usability.
* Monitor and report on ongoing compliance with internal standards and external frameworks.
* Identify, assess, and track vulnerabilities through remediation.
* Support incident response activities by organizing information, tracking actions, and assisting coordination.
* Validate that remediation actions are completed and effective.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports related to asset visibility, vulnerability status, configuration changes, control effectiveness, and compliance posture.
* Track and report control gaps, deficiencies, and remediation status to support assurance and audit readiness.
* Support audit, compliance, and assurance activities by maintaining documentation, organizing and maintaining evidence, supporting control walkthroughs and documentation, and tracking requirements aligned with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, NERC CIP, or similar.
* Provide clear, structured reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, security guidelines, and internal standards.
* Ensure documentation is consistent, current, and aligned across teams.
* Support enforcement and adoption of security policies and standards across teams.
* Work closely with engineering and product teams, operations and field personnel, OT and IT security teams, and regulatory and compliance stakeholders.

**EY – Cybersecurity Manager, Identity & Access Management (IAM)**
**Overview**
As Manager in EY’s Cybersecurity practice, you will play a key role in delivering Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across multiple client environments. We are seeking cybersecurity professionals with expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management (AM), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) such as Microsoft Entra ID, IBM Security Verify Governance, IBM Security Verify Access, Delinea Secret Server, SailPoint Identity or other leading IAM technologies.
  
  
The role involves implementing, administering, and optimizing IAM solutions that enable secure user access, enforce governance controls, manage privileged accounts, and support regulatory compliance across IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking cybersecurity professionals with 12+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance, Access Management, Privileged Access Management, or Cybersecurity Consulting.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in identity lifecycle management, role-based access controls, authentication and authorization mechanisms, privileged account governance, and IAM operational processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Identity Governance & Administration**

* Implement and administer IGA solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Saviynt, IBM, SailPoint Identity and Oracle Identity Governance.
* Configure identity lifecycle management processes, including joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
* Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, and access certification campaigns.
* Design and maintain role-based access control (RBAC) models.
* Support Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and policy enforcement.
* Perform access reviews, user entitlement analysis, and compliance reporting.
* Integrate governance workflows with enterprise applications and directories.
* Support audit and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Access Management & Federation**

* Deploy and administer access management platforms such as IBM Security Verify Access, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or Ping Identity.
* Configure authentication and authorization policies for enterprise applications.
* Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and adaptive access controls.
* Support federation technologies including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and WS-Federation.
* Integrate applications with centralized authentication platforms.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, and federation-related issues.
* Support secure remote access and external identity integrations.
* Participate in access management modernization and transformation initiatives.

**Privileged Access Management**

* Administer Delinea Secret Server platforms for privileged credential management.
* Manage privileged account onboarding, credential vaulting, and password rotation.
* Configure privileged session management and privileged access workflows.
* Support discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, applications, and network devices.
* Implement least-privilege principles and privileged-access governance controls.
* Monitor privileged account activities and support audit requirements.
* Assist in remediation of privileged-access risks and compliance findings.
* Support PAM integrations with enterprise identity systems.

**OT Privileged Access Management**

* Support PAM implementation across Operational Technology and industrial environments.
* Secure privileged access to OT assets, systems, and administrative accounts.
* Enforce access governance controls for critical OT infrastructure.
* Support compliance and operational requirements while maintaining security controls.
* Collaborate with OT engineering and security teams during onboarding and implementation activities.

**IAM Operations & Security Governance**

* Support IAM operational activities across multiple client environments.
* Participate in identity governance, compliance, audit, and risk management initiatives.
* Develop and maintain IAM operational procedures, standards, and documentation.
* Conduct entitlement reviews, access risk assessments, and remediation activities.
* Support security incidents involving identity and access misuse.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
* Participate in IAM transformation, cloud identity, and Zero Trust initiatives.
* Contribute to process improvement and automation efforts.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Access Management, and Privileged Access Management concepts.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, federation, and access-control technologies.
* Experience with RBAC, SoD, access certification, and identity lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust and Identity-Centric Security principles.
* Understanding of Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise identity architectures.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting IAM.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or related disciplines.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in Identity and Access Management.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ IBM Security Verify Governance; experience with SailPoint or Oracle Identity Governance is preferred
+ IBM Security Verify Access; experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or Ping Identity is preferred
+ Delinea Secret Server

* Strong understanding of:

+ Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
+ Access Management (AM)
+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
+ Single Sign-On (SSO)
+ Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
+ Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ Segregation of Duties (SoD)

* Experience integrating IAM solutions with enterprise applications and directories.
* Understanding of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, LDAP, and Active Directory.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**What We Look For**
Professionals who are passionate about identity security and access governance, possess strong technical and analytical capabilities, and demonstrate a proactive approach to securing enterprise identities and privileged access. Successful candidates will have a strong customer-focused mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality IAM services while collaborating effectively within global cybersecurity teams.

* Experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Zero Trust frameworks.

* Collaborative environment with exposure to global enterprise applications.

Continuous learning and certification support

**IAM Secure Access Engineer**
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.
  
  
Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As EY accelerates the adoption of Frontier AI, Generative AI, AI Agents, and Autonomous Workflows, identity has become a critical security control for protecting enterprise systems, data, and digital assets. AI-powered solutions increasingly access sensitive information, interact with business applications, make decisions, and execute actions on behalf of users, creating new and complex identity security challenges.
  
  
The IAM Secure Access Engineer will be responsible for designing, governing, and securing AI identities, agent permissions, and access controls across the organization. This role will help establish mature security frameworks that align with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance standards. By providing dedicated expertise in AI-focused identity security, this position will play a key role in reducing organizational risk, strengthening compliance, and enabling the safe, scalable adoption of AI technologies across EY.
  
  
The role combines traditional IAM engineering fundamentals with delivery of new Secure Access initiatives across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, PlainID, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, workload identities, token protection and secrets or certificate-based authentication.
  
  
The engineer will work with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions and move changes through design, build, test, production deployment and operational handover.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**AI Identity Governance & Security**

* Design, implement, and maintain identity governance frameworks for AI agents, machine identities, autonomous workflows, and Generative AI platforms.
* Establish lifecycle management processes for AI identities, including provisioning, credential management, authentication, authorization, and deprovisioning.
* Define and enforce policies governing AI agent access to enterprise systems, applications, APIs, and sensitive data.
* Develop controls to ensure AI systems operate within approved permissions and business boundaries.

**Authentication, Federation & Access Engineering**

* Design, configure and support authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related standards.
* Implement and maintain MFA, single sign-on, passwordless authentication and risk-based access controls.
* Configure and troubleshoot PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.
* Support onboarding and migration of applications to modern authentication patterns.
* Analyze authentication failures, policy conflicts, token issues and user access problems across integrated platforms.

**Conditional Access & Identity Protection**

* Implement and enhance Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies, authentication strengths, authentication contexts and protected actions.
* Support Continuous Access Evaluation, token protection, sign-in risk controls and secure administrative access patterns.
* Assess policy impact, exclusions, break-glass requirements and deployment risks before production release.
* Use logs and platform telemetry to validate control effectiveness and investigate access issues.

**Authorization, Workload Identity & Secrets**

* Implement policy-based authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization platforms.
* Support role-based, attribute-based and policy-based access control patterns.
* Improve security for service principals, managed identities, application identities and other non-human identities.
* Support migration from shared secrets to managed identity, certificates or approved vault-based patterns.
* Coordinate certificate, key and secret lifecycle activities with PKI, vault and application teams.

**Engineering Delivery & Operations**

* Create technical designs, implementation plans, test cases, rollback plans and operational documentation.
* Raise and manage Change Requests and support production deployments through established controls.
* Automate repeatable administration and validation tasks using PowerShell, REST APIs or other approved scripting methods.
* Perform unit, integration, regression and security testing and support post-deployment validation.
* Participate in incident, problem, vulnerability remediation and continual improvement activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, identity federation, MFA, SSO and Zero Trust principles.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta or PlainID.
* Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos and RADIUS.
* Experience with Conditional Access, Identity Protection, workload identities or modern authentication controls.
* PowerShell or comparable scripting experience and the ability to work with REST APIs, JSON and certificates.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, testing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Understanding of secure software delivery, ITSM, Change Management and production support practices.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise platform support.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD.
* Experience creating deployment pipelines and release automation.
* Basic containerization knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
* Experience configuring or supporting enterprise authentication and access management solutions.
* Experience delivering controlled changes across development, test and production environments.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, document findings and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, Ping Identity products, Okta or PlainID.
* Knowledge of passwordless authentication, FIDO2, certificate-based authentication and PKI.
* Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or another enterprise secrets platform.
* Cloud platform knowledge in Azure and familiarity with CI/CD or infrastructure automation.
* Relevant Microsoft, Ping Identity, Okta, security or ITIL certification.

**What We Look For**
We look for a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with curiosity about emerging authentication and authorization controls. The successful candidate is structured, security-minded and comfortable collaborating across application, infrastructure, architecture and operations teams.
  
  
**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior ICT, AV & Security Consultant to join our team in Kochi, India.

The successful candidate will lead and deliver ICT, Audio Visual (AV), Security, and Extra Low Voltage (ELV) design and consultancy services across a diverse range of projects. * Manage project workloads, allocate resources, and monitor team performance to ensure efficient project delivery.

**Techinal Scope**

* ICT / Data and Network Infrastructure
* Structured Cabling and Wireless Network Systems
* CCTV / Video Surveillance Systems
* Access Control and Intrusion Detection Systems
* Intercom and Video Intercom Systems
* Audio Visual (AV) Systems
* Smart Building / IoT Systems
* Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Infrastructure
* Multidisciplinary Design Coordination
* Design Drawings, Specifications, and Equipment Schedules
* Tender Documentation and Technical Submissions
* BIM Coordination, Clash Detection, and Constructability Reviews
* Application of Relevant Standards, Regulations, and Industry Guidelines

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* 13–15 years of relevant experience in ICT, AV, Security, and ELV design consultancy.
* Strong technical knowledge of ICT infrastructure, structured cabling, security systems, AV systems, and integrated ELV solutions.
* Proven experience in leading engineering teams and managing design deliverables across multiple projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM workflows, multidisciplinary coordination, and clash detection processes.
* Experience in preparing design reports, technical specifications, tender documents, and detailed engineering drawings.

* Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a short cover letter outlining their relevant experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and key project portfolio to heyhr@designconfidence.me.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.

title: Senior Audit Analyst
description:
**Job Overview**
Hubbell Incorporated is a best-in-class provider of Utility and Electrical solutions that enable customers to operate critical infrastructure Reliably and Efficiently. We Empower and Energize communities through innovative solutions in Front of and Behind the Meter.
  
  
Join us as we pursue creating a more sustainable company and future for our customers and value chain. We are looking for a Senior IT Audit Analyst to provide support for testing and reporting on IT general controls. A great role for a professional with a background in data analysis, data science, IT audit and/or IT security assurance.
  
  
A Day In The Life
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will be supporting Hubbell Internal Audit by testing and reporting on IT general controls. Technical skills to understand IT control testing from various technologies including – SAP, other ERPs, Azure, Aws, Cybersecurity and conduct end-end test work are required. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Work with Internal Audit and stakeholders to execute IT audit procedures.
* Assist with annual Sarbanes Oxley (SOX) IT audits and other audits as assigned.
* Develop workpapers for planning, fieldwork and reporting phases.
* Retrieve data independently from SAP, other applications and tools to analyse, test and report.
* Proficient in Microsoft tools, especially Excel, Word and PowerBi.
* Lead process understanding walkthroughs and document IT process understanding.
* Execute controls testing and provide daily status update.
* Participate in reporting phase and update Audit tools to document test results.
* Conduct issue remediation reviews.
* Identify opportunities of improvement to deliver quality work and continuous audit approach.

What will help you thrive in this role?
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Have The Following Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant technology audit experience.
* Advanced knowledge of working with MS Excel. Working knowledge of SAP ERP.
* Active CISA or other relevant certificates from ISACA or other reputed institutes.
* Detail oriented, analytical, quality obsessed with excellent communication skills.
* Experience working in global teams and available to overlap EST time zone work hours.
* Experience working in team environments with technical and non-technical users.
* Self-motivated with excellent time management to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

**Hubbell Incorporated**
Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.
  
  
The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.
  
  
We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.
  
  
**Hubbell Unified Business Solutions**
Hubbell Unified Business Services (HUBS) provides corporate shared services to support all businesses across the enterprise. Functional areas include Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Payroll, Environmental Health & Safety, and Compliance. HUBS employees are located around the world.
  
  
Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.
  
  
The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

* Manage onshore stakeholder expectations, delivery plans, communications, escalations, governance rhythms, and operational cadences to ensure reliable, responsive, and high-quality Cyber Alliance operations support
* Proactively identify, document, and deliver opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, standardize operating routines, automate repeatable activities, and leverage Agentic AI responsibly to improve quality, speed, insight generation, and stakeholder experience across Cyber Alliance operations

* Strong grounding in sales, pipeline, and alliance operations, with practical understanding of opportunity life cycles, pipeline hygiene, GTM reporting, and Cyber Alliance performance measures
* Strong technology orientation with genuine interest in cyber services, cyber ecosystem partnerships, partner program models, and technology-led growth opportunities
